text:
sam_support: customer reporting token cost tiles show $0 or NaN for some orgs (org: org_0xA12). Screenshot: https://redwood-internal.s3/obs/anon/snap123.png

maya_product: thanks — can you confirm timeframe and whether this is for both embeddings + generation or only generation?

sam_support: last 24h, both. Customer says numbers were normal yesterday, started ~05:30 UTC. They attached CSV export where cost column is 0 or NaN for ~40 rows.

ben_eng: assigning to data-eng to triage, putting debug query below. @ben_eng taking lead.

ben_eng: repro query i ran quickly (psql):
```sql
SELECT u.org_id, u.model_alias, SUM(u.tokens) AS tokens, p.price_per_token
FROM public.usage_hourly u
LEFT JOIN public.model_prices p ON u.model_alias = p.alias
WHERE u.org_id = 'org_0xA12' AND u.hour >= now() - interval '24 hours'
GROUP BY 1,2,4;
```

ben_eng: result: several rows where price_per_token is NULL -> frontend ends up rendering $0 or NaN depending on aggregation.

oliver_sre: interesting — where are prices populated from? model-pricing-service cache, updated by pricing-sync job. Any errors in pricing-sync around 05:20-05:40 UTC?

dev-bot: pricing-sync job run at 2026-03-16T05:15:23Z -> exit code 0
dev-bot: pricing-sync job run at 2026-03-16T05:35:11Z -> exit code 1

ben_eng: logs from pricing-sync (snippet):
```
2026-03-16T05:35:11Z ERROR pricing-sync: failed to fetch model catalog for region us-east-1, exception: KeyError('gpt-open-v3-int8')
2026-03-16T05:35:11Z ERROR pricing-sync: aborting update, leaving cache partial
```

ben_eng: root cause hypothesis: model alias rename happened yesterday (gpt-open-v3 -> gpt-open-v3-int8 alias added), pricing-sync encountered unexpected alias key and aborted, leaving some model aliases without price entries. Downstream dashboard query joins to model_prices and yields NULL price.

maya_product: that would explain why only some orgs are impacted (those using that model variant). Also explains timestamp.

sam_support: customer impacted is on dedicated + some hosted requests -> they saw mixed rows. Customer is asking for ETA on fix.

ben_eng: immediate mitigation options:
- hotfix pricing-sync to tolerate unknown keys and continue partial updates (fast)
- backfill missing prices via one-off job reading last-known-good pricing snapshots (medium)
- frontend: treat NULL price as fallback to last_known_price or show "price unavailable" instead of $0/NaN (UX)

oliver_sre: I can deploy a hotfix to pricing-sync to change KeyError->log+continue, then re-run job. Patch and deploy in ~30m if no objections.

maya_product: go ahead with hotfix + backfill. Notify customer after re-run.

ben_eng: actions I'm taking now:
1) creating backfill job to populate model_prices for the last 72h from pricing snapshots: `scripts/backfill_prices --from 2026-03-13 --to 2026-03-16 --models gpt-open-v3-int8`
2) running the hotfix branch in staging to validate no regression

sam_support: i'll tell the customer we expect a fix within ~1h and we'll follow up when numbers repopulate, thanks.

acct_jordan: FYI finance — affected orgs may show $0 for billing exports until backfill completes, please hold any automatic notifications for ~24h.

ben_eng: repro steps for others:
1) curl dashboard API to fetch cost tiles for org: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://console.redwood.ai/api/orgs/org_0xA12/metrics/costs?range=24h"`
2) run SQL above to confirm NULL prices

ben_eng: temp query to list all impacted orgs (sql):
```sql
SELECT DISTINCT u.org_id
FROM public.usage_hourly u
LEFT JOIN public.model_prices p ON u.model_alias = p.alias
WHERE p.price_per_token IS NULL AND u.hour >= now() - interval '24 hours';
```

oliver_sre: hotfix deployed to pricing-sync staging, re-run scheduled, will push to prod after green smoke.

dev-bot: pricing-sync prod run triggered by oliver_sre at 2026-03-16T06:05:12Z

dev-bot: pricing-sync prod run -> exit code 0 at 2026-03-16T06:05:45Z

ben_eng: re-ran the earlier SELECT, price_per_token now populated for affected aliases. Backfill started, should finish in ~20m for last 72h.

sam_support: just updated customer — they say numbers look much better already, a few rows still NaN but shrinking. They want confirmation when backfill completes.

maya_product: follow-ups:
- add defensive change to pricing-sync to never abort entire update on single unknown alias
- add alert for price table gaps (daily job that ensures no alias with usage has NULL price)
- UX change: dashboard should show "price missing" instead of $0/NaN

ben_eng: created internal ticket RFC#INFR-3242 for the alert + fix, assigned to data-eng.

sam_support: will follow up with customer when backfill done, keeping thread open. :thumbsup:
